Special Branch
Misc. 567/40.
LOUGA MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTRY
335
Stone thrown at Japanese Military M/car injuring Japanese Officer
D.S.I. Wilkinson.

Sir,
At 3.45 p.m. on the 23-8-40 notification was received at this Station from the D.O."A" Div.that at 1 p.m. on the 23-8-40 a stone had been thrown through the open window of a Japanese Military M/car No.601 striking a Japanese Officer Lieut. Ooya, above the left eye and causing injuries(extent not known).
Enquiries by D.S.I. Wilkinson, D.P.S.689 Masumoto, J.R.B. and C.D.7.98 ascertained the following information
At 1 p.m. the above car, a sedan, was proceeding West to East along Nanking Road with all side windows rolled down, being occupied by Lieut.Ooya, Sub.Lieut. Ando(both in the rear seats) 2nd Class Private Hosokawa, driving the car, and 1st Class Private Watanabe seated beside him. When approaching the North west corner of the Nanking Road Kiangsu Road intersection, approximately three yards from the pavement edge, a male Chinese standing on the north west corner threw a stone into the open rear left window of the car, this striking the aforementioned officer. Description of the perpetrator supplied by the occupants was as follows:
A male Chinese age about 17 years, height about 5'8", wearing Khaki shorts, white shirt, stockings and Chinese straw hat, thin features, dark complexion of the Coolie type. Carrying a basket in his left hand.
The car was travelling about 10 miles per hour, and, following the incident, failed to stop but proceeded upon its journey, occupants making no attempt to report the matter to S.P.C.833 on Traffic Section. Four passes

老闸捕房警务处
登记室
335
有人向日本军用汽车投掷石块，致一名日本军官受伤
副督察威尔金森（Wilkinson）。

先生：
1940年8月23日下午3时45分，本站接到“A”分区巡官的通知，称在1940年8月23日下午1时，有人将一块石头扔进编号为601的日本军用汽车敞开的车窗，击中日本大尉大屋（Ooya）左眼上方，造成伤害（程度不详）。
经副督察威尔金森、日籍警探689号增本（Masumoto）、日本租界警察及华籍侦探7.98号调查，查明以下情况：
下午1时，上述轿车沿南京路由西向东行驶，所有侧窗均摇下。车内人员包括：坐在后座的大尉大屋（Ooya）和少尉安藤（Ando），驾驶车辆的二等兵细川（Hosokawa），以及坐在他旁边的一等兵渡边（Watanabe）。当车辆驶近南京路与江苏路交叉口的西北角，距离人行道边缘约三码处时，一名站在西北角的华籍男子将一块石头扔进汽车左后方的敞开车窗，击中了前述军官。据车内人员提供的肇事者体貌特征如下：
华籍男子，年龄约17岁，身高约5英尺8英寸，身穿卡其色短裤、白衬衫、长袜，头戴草帽，面容清瘦，肤色黝黑，呈苦力类型。左手提着一只篮子。
当时车速约为每小时10英里，事发后车辆并未停下，而是继续前行，车内人员也未试图向交通科833号巡警报告此事。四次通行

sheet 2.

away. Report made to the Japanese Military Headquarters,
resulting in later attendance at the scene of the
occupants of the car, Capt. Otsuka, Military Headquarters;
Lieut. Usri, Military Defence Force and members of the
Japanese Consular Police and Gendarmerie who made
investigations.
The offence was outlined, notes and photographs
taken and the stone (broken) produced, this being
part of a building brick, about four inches in length,
one inch in depth and width.
S.P.C. 835 was interrogated but stated that no
report of any untoward incident was reported to him,
neither had he observed anything of this nature occur.
Statement taken.
S.P.C. 836 on Traffic Post No. 3 on the South side
of the Nanking Road Hungjoo Road intersection also
failed to observe anything unusual take place.
The authorities concerned are forwarding an
official letter to Police in connection with the
offence.

D.S.I.
C.D.S. 98.

Sen. Det. I/C.

D.D.O. "A" Div.

第2页。

离开。随后向日本军方总部报告，
导致后来汽车乘员、军方总部的大冢（Otsuka）上尉、
国防军乌斯里（Usri）中尉以及日本领事馆警察和宪兵队成员
前往现场进行调查。
概述了罪行，做了笔记并拍摄了照片，出示了
（破碎的）石块，该石块是建筑用砖的一部分，
长约四英寸，厚度和宽度各为一英寸。
对835号巡警进行了讯问，但他表示未收到任何
关于此类意外事件的报告，他也未观察到发生
此类事情。已录取供词。
驻南京路与虹口路交叉口南侧3号交通岗的
836号巡警也表示未观察到任何异常情况发生。
有关当局正就此事向警方发送正式公函。

副督察
华籍侦探组长 98号。

高级侦探主管

“A”分区副巡官

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of S.P.C. 533 Thuman Singh.
native of India. taken by me
at za Station on the 23.8.40. and interpreted by S.P.C. 391.

Sir,
I beg to state that on 23.8.40 I was on traffic Post No. 8
at the intersection of Nanking and Kwangs' Road from 12noon to
4 p.m. Between that time I supervised traffic but I did not
see any incident involving a Japanese Military car, or suspicious
persons loitering in the vicinity. No person made any report
to me concerning any such incident.

True Statement. Sd: S.P.C. 533 Thuman Singh,

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警务调查报告。

以下为印度籍533号巡警图曼·辛格（Thuman Singh）的供词，
由本人于1940年8月23日在乍浦路站录取，
并由391号巡警翻译。

先生：
谨陈述如下：1940年8月23日，中午12时至下午4时，
我在南京路与广西路交叉口的8号交通岗执勤。在此期间，
我负责指挥交通，但未看到涉及日本军用汽车的任何事件，
也未见可疑人员在附近徘徊。无人向我报告
任何此类事件。

属实供词。签署：533号巡警 图曼·辛格，

Louza Stn. 23-8-40. Clerk Koo Ting I

I beg to report that between 12 noon and 4 p.m.
on the 23-8-40 I was on Traffic Post at the intersection of
Nanking and Kwangse Roads. During the time stated I did not
see any incident regarding a Japanese Motor car taking place
nor was any report of this nature made to me.

True statement.

Sd.C.P.C.886 Hong Ching Foo.

老闸站 1940年8月23日。书记员 顾廷一（Koo Ting I）

谨报告如下：1940年8月23日中午12时至下午4时期间，
我在南京路与广西路交叉口的交通岗执勤。在上述时间内，
